summary: Discussion-first snapshot: vendor agent platform updates (Google/OpenAI/GitLab/OpenHands) plus operator reports on agent workflows, browser-driving runtimes, eval/security concerns, and several open-source agent projects gaining chatter. | Vendor announcements and security advisories: Microsoft Foundry and AWS Quick push deployment/runtime features for enterprise agents; multiple GHSA advisories impact agent infra (MCP, Claude Code, mem0); OpenRouter flags inference-provider data policy issues; operator case studies show sandbox and risk-assessment workflows. | GitHub-only snapshot: mix of vendor releases (Cloudflare, Anthropic, Qwen, Browser-Use, Dify) plus notable infra primitives (sandbox runtimes, memory stores, detections). No social/operator posts in this shard; several repo-only signals need independent corroboration before promotion. | Package-layer signals: mix of high-traction mainstream agent extensions and vendor MCP/runtime packages (OpenAI, Amazon, BrowserStack, Vercel), plus infra primitives for detection, eval, memory and sandboxing. Few social/operator reports in this shard; many packages are single-source and need corroboration.
